description: This Java source file defines an enum RatingScale, which represents different rating levels for books in the project. It includes associated string representations and numerical values, and provides utility methods for conversions between the enum and numerical values.

classes.name: RatingScale
classes.description: An enum representing various rating levels for books, each with a display string and an optional numerical value. Includes methods to convert to and from numerical ratings.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the rating, e.g., '7/10'.

methods.name: toDouble
methods.description: Converts a RatingScale enum to its corresponding Double value, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Retrieves a RatingScale enum corresponding to the given Double value, wrapped in an Optional.
